One of `headless-shell, ` `chrome-for-testing`. Default `headless-shell`. [Use `chrome-for-testing` to take advantage of GPU drivers on Linux.](/docs/miscellaneous/chrome-headless-shell)

## CLI flag

Use `--chrome-mode` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                           | Flag                    |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)             | `--chrome-mode <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)             | `--chrome-mode <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)               | `--chrome-mode <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions) | `--chrome-mode <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)       | `--chrome-mode <value>` |
| [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)                   | `--chrome-mode <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`ensureBrowser()`](/docs/renderer/ensure-browser#chromemode)
- [`getCompositions()`](/docs/renderer/get-compositions#chromemode)
- [`openBrowser()`](/docs/renderer/open-browser#chromemode)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#chromemode)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#chromemode)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#chromemode)
- [`selectComposition()`](/docs/renderer/select-composition#chromemode)

## Config file

```tsx twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';

// ---cut---

Config.setChromeMode('chrome-for-testing');
```
